## Experiment checklist

<!-- Follow CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

- [ ] My experiment is in `<region>-<author>-<YYYYMMDD>/` (maintainers can omit `<author>`)
- [ ] I added a `README.md` that tells about the experiment, the configuration and the results
- [ ] I included `report.html`, made in TAREEK with `python scripts/experiment_report.py experiments/<experiment-id> --no-pdf --link-images`, and all the `evaluation/` images that it links to
- [ ] I opened the copied `report.html` in a browser and it shows all the images
- [ ] I included `config_used.json`, `config.xml` and the related small result CSVs / figures
- [ ] I did **not** commit large inputs or inputs that TAREEK can make again (such as OSM extracts or MATSim networks/plans)
- [ ] My contribution is less than 50 MB
- [ ] I replaced all live API keys and secrets in the configuration and other files with placeholders
- [ ] I listed the external services or keys that are necessary to do the experiment again
- [ ] I have the right to share the data, and my `README.md` gives the source and license of each input dataset (for example, OpenStreetMap data is ODbL)
- [ ] I agree that my example is available under CC BY 4.0 (see `LICENSE`)
- [ ] I added my experiment to the table in `README.md`
